The '''Study Circle''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The various circles on Kegan formed an interconnected ring around the [[Gathering Circle]] at the city's center. The Study Circle was connected to the [[Communication Circle]] on one side and the [[Garden Circle]] on the other.<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
